sentences.text: The genus Bdellodus is monotypic, meaning it contains only one species, B. bollensis.
Scientists originally described this genus based on associated teeth found together.
Bdellodus is often classified within the subfamily Acrodontinae, a group of durophagous (shell-crushing) hybodont sharks.
This shark lived during the Early Jurassic epoch.
Its time range is estimated to be between 184.2 and 174.7 million years ago.
Fossils have been found in the Toarcian stage of Germany.
